entities.name: Naya
entities.description: A jungle shard of Alara of dense jungles and steep mountains with gargantuans, lacking blue and black magic.

entities.name: Nacatl
entities.description: Leonin cat-people of Naya who once ruled the plane in the Empire of the Clouds and now live in the mountains and ruins.

entities.name: Empire of the Clouds
entities.description: The fallen Nacatl empire, destroyed by internal strife.

entities.name: Claws of Marisi
entities.description: Revolutionary Nacatl group that waged guerilla war and broke the Coil.

entities.name: Pride of Judges
entities.description: Elite Nacatl group that enforced the Coil with threats of harm.

entities.name: The Coil
entities.description: A convoluted system of Nacatl laws recorded on a massive stone wall, broken by Marisi's revolutionaries.

entities.name: Qasal
entities.description: A Nacatl mountain city that remains a stronghold.

entities.name: Elves of Naya
entities.description: Nomadic canopy-dwelling elves who worship the gargantuans and now surpass the Nacatl.

entities.name: Mayael the Anima
entities.description: Leader of the elves of Naya.

entities.name: Progenitus
entities.description: An enormous five-headed hydra sleeping under the ground in the Valley of the Ancient, whose signs the elves read in the behemoths.

entities.name: Gargantuans
entities.description: Enormous creatures of Naya that can crush human settlements.

entities.name: Humans of Naya
entities.description: People living on the dangerous forest floor, building villages and fighting jungle growth.

entities.name: Grixis
entities.description: Realm of disease, horror and the undead.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A planeswalker born into a pride of Wild Nacatl on Naya.

events.summary: Internal strife destroys the Nacatl Empire of the Clouds as the Claws of Marisi wage guerilla war.
events.quote: But internal strife destroyed the empire.

events.summary: The Claws of Marisi and Pride of Judges fight in the streets and the revolutionaries triumph, breaking the Coil.
events.quote: In the end, Marisi's revolutionaries triumphed and the Coil was broken.

events.summary: The elves expand and surpass the Nacatl as dominant race; hostility grows as Wild Nacatl move into the lowlands.
events.quote: The elves are expanding their territory in Naya and have surpassed the Nacatl as the dominant race on the plane.

relations.quote: Led by Mayael the Anima, the elves worship the gargantuans of the plane.
the Claws of Marisi and the Pride of Judges fought for dominance.
